coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 8 ground-truth variable items (75%): L2 tasks, L3 tasks, standard prompting (Direct Action/No-CoT), Chain-of-Thought prompting, GPT-4o, and Task Completion Rate (Task Success Rate).
coverage.design_error_analysis: GPT-3.5 is missing, and accuracy is not defined as an evaluation metric. The design also expands the specified L2/L3 task scope to include L1 tasks and adds Claude and Llama models beyond the specified model comparison.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was provided stating that CoT is expected to improve task completion rates and accuracy over standard prompting, especially on complex multi-step tasks.
